name: Hungover
description: Generic morning-after state. Apply with [state <char> -> hungover]. Layers headache, nausea and light-sensitivity onto the character; overlays append to existing anatomy prose.

properties.affect_summary: Hungover — pounding head, queasy stomach, raw and irritable. Light and noise are unwelcome; everything takes more effort than it should.
properties.mannerism_overlay: Winces at bright light and loud sounds, pinches the bridge of her nose, moves carefully to avoid jostling her head, snaps shorter than usual.

body_overlays.head: Her face is pale and drawn, eyes squinted against the light with dark smudges of fatigue beneath them; she keeps pressing fingertips to her temple.
body_overlays.midriff: Her stomach is uneasy, a hand drifting to it now and then as nausea rolls through.
